summary: Situated in a pleasant residential area of Northallerton, this well-proportioned three bedroom semi-detached home on St Anthony Avenue offers spacious and comfortable living, ideal for families or professional tenants. The property features a bright and welcoming living room, a generous kitchen with ample storage and dining space, and three good-sized bedrooms providing flexibility for family life, guests or home working. The layout offers practical living with well-balanced accommodation throughout. Externally, the property benefits from a private garden — perfect for relaxing or entertaining — along with off-street parking and a garage. Being semi-detached, the home enjoys additional privacy and natural light. A fantastic opportunity to rent a spacious home in a sought-after area. Early viewing is highly recommended.
